definitions.explanation: A botanical family of flowering plants centered on lilies and tulips. {科|か} is the suffix for a biological family. (In traditional classifications it also took in plants like onions, though modern systems often place those elsewhere.)

examples.japanese: ⟦チューリップ→チューリップ：05487_chuurippu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ユリ{科|か}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧だ。
examples.english: The tulip is a flower of the lily family.

examples.japanese: ユリ{科|か}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{植物|しょくぶつ}→植物：03248_shokubutsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{球根|きゅうこん}→球根：18744_kyuukon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧もの⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many plants in the lily family have bulbs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ネギや⟦ニラ→ニラ：11111_nira⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ユリ{科|か}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分類|ぶんるい}→分類：04790_bunrui⟧⟦されていた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In the past, green onions and garlic chives were also classified in the lily family.

notes:
The biological family Liliaceae. The suffix {科|か} marks a taxonomic family; the family name precedes it, here written in katakana as ユリ.

NOTABLE MEMBERS:
- ⟦{百合|ゆり}→百合：04395_yuri⟧: lily
- ⟦チューリップ→チューリップ：05487_chuurippu⟧: tulip
